source.source_name: KAP — Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu (Public Disclosure Platform)

transport.rate_limit: public; client-side data fetch (Next.js); pace requests

parsing.notes: Enumerate listed companies from /tr/bist-sirketler (links /tr/sirket-bilgileri/ozet/{kapId}-{slug}). Per-company page holds identity + financial statements (Bilanço/Gelir Tablosu, TFRS, TRY) + disclosures. JSON API endpoints have moved; use the site pages / current API. Verify KAP/Borsa terms before redistribution. Listed only.

mapping_rules.financials: financials.balance_income per period (TRY): revenue/net profit/total assets.
mapping_rules.join: kap_id / company name / VKN -> MERSIS identity.

fixture_requirements: listed company with annual financial statements

live_test_plan.smoke: GET /tr/bist-sirketler; extract kapId+name; fetch one company page.
live_test_plan.full: Iterate the ~800 listed companies; pull financial statements (TRY); join to MERSIS. Pace requests; respect terms.

blockers: Listed companies only (~800); private-company financials not public.
KAP JSON API endpoints have moved; use the site pages / current API.
Reuse governed by KAP/Borsa İstanbul terms.
